overview: Pluber is a two-sided home services marketplace — like Uber but for outdoor and home maintenance. Homeowners post jobs with a price they're willing to pay, nearby workers get notified and accept jobs within their service radius. Payments are held in escrow until both parties confirm completion.
features: Homeowner job posting with budget and service category
Worker job discovery on an interactive map with service radius
Payment escrow — funds held until both parties confirm job completion
Worker onboarding with ID and insurance document upload
Dynamic worker radius expansion based on completed job count
Enterprise subcontracting tier for bulk job dispatch
Ratings and reviews for both homeowners and workers
In-app notification inbox for job updates
